structured.answer: I haven't decided anything. I'll ask my son and the bank. I understood that a deposit locks the money for a set time for interest, and that taking it out early costs a fine whose size the page doesn't give. But the example showing 70,000 in and 68,270 back, and the line "אין בישראל ביטוח פיקדונות", frightened me.

stuck.why: Big number 68,270 ₪ next to ההפקדות שלכם 70,000 ₪ looks like I lose money; 'בכסף של היום' / 'בשקלים של העתיד' not explained in words I understand
'123 מקור 123 מחושב 123 הזנתה' – no idea what these are
Says breaking early has a fine but 'האתר לא מחשב אותה' – so I still don't know what I give up
